name: Shipment of Iron
summary: In Hillsbrad Fields, a crate of raw iron waits at the human smithy. The metal feeds local arms production, making the shipment a target for Forsaken forces seeking to cut the supply lines that arm the townsfolk.

sections.title: Fueling the Resistance
sections.body: Across the Hillsbrad Foothills, human peasants have mounted stiff resistance against Tarren Mill. Much of their strength comes from the smithy at the southwestern edge of Hillsbrad Fields, where Blacksmith Verringtan and his apprentices work round the clock, making weapons and armor from heavy shipments of iron. Forsaken commanders ordered the forge put out, its smiths killed, and its stored metal seized for the Horde war effort, hoping to break the farmers’ resolve.

faq.q: Where is the shipment of iron kept?
faq.answer: The shipment is kept inside the blacksmith workshop at the southwestern edge of Hillsbrad Fields. Blacksmith Verringtan and his apprentices guard it closely.

faq.q: Why does the Forsaken want this iron?
faq.answer: The iron arms the local human militia, and the Forsaken want to cut off that supply. High Executor Darthalia also means to use the stockpiles for the Horde war machine when the offensive turns toward razing Southshore.

faq.q: Who was using this iron originally?
faq.answer: Blacksmith Verringtan and his four apprentice smiths used the iron to arm the townspeople and field workers, turning simple farmers into a local defense force against the undead.

faq.q: Who orders the retrieval of the iron shipment?
faq.answer: High Executor Darthalia, commanding Forsaken operations out of Tarren Mill, orders the smiths slain and the iron claimed during the Battle of Hillsbrad.

angles.text: For a blacksmith, raw iron keeps human arms production in the valley alive. Without the ingots, Verringtan’s forge sits useless.
As a member of the Horde, denying Hillsbrad supplies weakens the farmers’ armed resistance before the campaign moves against Southshore.
